SELECT 
    cr.clientref AS customer_identifier,
    cr.coreregistry,
    -- Employment & Income metrics
    ei.annlincome,
    ei.mthincome,
    ei.debincratio,
    ei.hshincome,
    -- Expenses & Assets metrics
    ea.mthexp,
    ea.savamount,
    ea.totassets,
    ea.totliabs,
    ea.networth,
    ea.bankaccbal,
    -- Bank & Transaction metrics
    bt.banktxamt,
    bt.bouncecount,
    bt.lifeinsval,
    bt.fraudrisk,
    -- Credit & Compliance metrics
    cc.credscore,
    cc.risklev,
    cc.delinqcount,
    cc.latepaycount,
    cc.collacc,
    cc.bankr,
    cc.credageyrs,
    -- Credit Accounts & History metrics
    ca.cardcount,
    ca.totcredlimit,
    ca.credutil,
    ca.loancount,
    ca.totloanamt,
    ca.custlifeval
FROM core_record cr
LEFT JOIN employment_and_income ei ON cr.coreregistry = ei.emplcoreref
LEFT JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ei.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref
LEFT JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON ea.expemplref = bt.bankexpref
LEFT JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON bt.bankexpref = cc.compbankref
LEFT JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON cc.compbankref = ca.histcompref;
